translationRepairs: In 1789 he was demoted to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
In 1789 he was demoted to academician of the Grand Secretariat.
s0008 is 左遷內閣學士; 內閣學士 is academician of the Grand Secretariat, not 大學士 (grand secretary). The replacement restores the correct office for this demotion.
In the fifty-fourth year he was demoted to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
In the fifty-fourth year he was demoted to academician of the Grand Secretariat.
The same unit s0008 literal also misrenders 內閣學士 as grand secretary; academician of the Grand Secretariat is the accurate title.
Liu Yong is already a grand secretary, while Da Chun has still not been advanced. Let favor be shown by restoring him as grand secretary with concurrent duty as deputy lieutenant-general.'

Liu Yong is already a grand secretary, while Da Chun has still not been advanced. Let favor be shown by restoring him as academician of the Grand Secretariat with concurrent duty as deputy lieutenant-general.'
s0012 contrasts 劉墉已為大學士 with 補授內閣學士兼副都統 for Da Chun; keeping grand secretary for Liu Yong and correcting Da Chun to academician of the Grand Secretariat restores that distinction.

After supervising the Guizhou provincial examination he moved through the Hanlin and Heir Apparent's household and was promoted step by step to grand secretary with a concurrent post as deputy lieutenant-general.

After supervising the Guizhou provincial examination he moved through the Hanlin and Heir Apparent's household and was promoted step by step to academician of the Grand Secretariat with a concurrent post as deputy lieutenant-general.
s0018 is 累遷內閣學士兼副都統; rendering 內閣學士 as grand secretary is wrong. Academician of the Grand Secretariat with concurrent deputy lieutenant-general matches the Chinese.
He was promoted to Hanlin reader-in-waiting while still serving in the Ministry of Personnel, then rose through reader and grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
He was promoted to Hanlin reader-in-waiting while still serving in the Ministry of Personnel, then rose through reader and academician of the Grand Secretariat.
s0033 ends 歷侍讀學士、內閣學士; 內閣學士 is not grand secretary. The proposed academician wording corrects that office only.

In 1799 he memorialized to impeach a clerk in his department; the emperor called his action excessive and demoted him to grand secretary, then posted him to Mukden as vice minister of war and of punishments with concurrent duty as metropolitan magistrate of Fengtian.

In 1799 he memorialized to impeach a clerk in his department; the emperor called his action excessive and demoted him to academician of the Grand Secretariat, then posted him to Mukden as vice minister of war and of punishments with concurrent duty as metropolitan magistrate of Fengtian.
s0037 has 左遷內閣學士; demotion to academician of the Grand Secretariat is accurate, whereas grand secretary confuses the title with 大學士.
He was soon made grand secretary but continued to serve in Tibet.
He was soon made academician of the Grand Secretariat but continued to serve in Tibet.
s0080 is 尋授內閣學士，仍留藏辦事; the office conferred is academician of the Grand Secretariat, not grand secretary.
Within a few years he rose step by step to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
Within a few years he rose step by step to academician of the Grand Secretariat.
s0113 is 累擢內閣學士; grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat misidentifies the rank. Academician of the Grand Secretariat is correct.
